title: Crime Investigation Case Management System
initialRequest: Our detectives are buried in paperwork and we keep losing track of evidence between cases. We need a system to help us manage our investigations better.
description: A metropolitan police department's Criminal Investigation Division (CID) is struggling to manage a growing caseload with paper files and disconnected spreadsheets. The scenario should help the developer uncover the real underlying needs behind the department's request — not just "digitize our files."
